name: Orbital Economy v7.7.2 Construction Materials Energy candidate r1
description: Task 012: Construction Materials processing becomes the third colony energy consumer; production planning uses a smoothed demand-signal stock to avoid the same-step allocator loop.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Energy Enabled
add_elements.description: v7.7.2 switch: makes Construction Materials processing participate in the colony energy allocator.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Energy per Unit
add_elements.description: Energy required per unit of Construction Materials processing.

add_elements.name: Construction Materials Demand Signal Adjustment Time
add_elements.description: Adjustment time for the smoothed Construction Materials demand signal.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Demand Signal
add_elements.description: Smoothed Construction Materials demand signal for colony A; breaks same-step allocator causality.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Demand Signal Increase

behavior.value: IfThenElse([A Construction Materials Demand] > [A Construction Materials Demand Signal], ([A Construction Materials Demand] - [A Construction Materials Demand Signal]) / [Construction Materials Demand Signal Adjustment Time], 0)

add_elements.description: Upward adjustment of colony A Construction Materials demand signal.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Demand Signal Decrease

behavior.value: IfThenElse([A Construction Materials Demand Signal] > [A Construction Materials Demand], ([A Construction Materials Demand Signal] - [A Construction Materials Demand]) / [Construction Materials Demand Signal Adjustment Time], 0)

add_elements.description: Downward adjustment of colony A Construction Materials demand signal.

add_elements.name: A Pre Energy Construction Materials Production Rate

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Enabled] = 1, [A Desired Construction Materials Production] / (1 + ([A Desired Construction Materials Production] / ([A Construction Materials Production Capacity] + 0.001)) ^ 8) ^ 0.125 * [A Regolith Inventory] / ([A Regolith Inventory] + [Regolith Buffer Days] * Max([A Regolith Requirement], 0.000000001)), 0)

add_elements.description: Colony A Construction Materials production plan before energy rationing; verbatim v7.7.1 production-rate formula.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Requested Energy

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Energy Enabled] = 1, [A Pre Energy Construction Materials Production Rate] * [Construction Materials Energy per Unit], 0)

add_elements.description: Energy requested by colony A Construction Materials processing.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Allocated Energy

behavior.value: [A Construction Materials Requested Energy] * [A Energy Fulfillment Ratio]

add_elements.description: Energy allocated to colony A Construction Materials processing by the common proportional allocator.

add_elements.name: A Construction Materials Energy Fulfillment Ratio

behavior.value: IfThenElse([A Construction Materials Requested Energy] > 0.001, [A Construction Materials Allocated Energy] / [A Construction Materials Requested Energy], 1)

add_elements.description: Energy fulfillment ratio of colony A Construction Materials processing.

add_elements.name: B Construction Materials Demand Signal
add_elements.description: Smoothed Construction Materials demand signal for colony B; breaks same-step allocator causality.

add_elements.name: B Construction Materials Demand Signal Increase

behavior.value: IfThenElse([B Construction Materials Demand] > [B Construction Materials Demand Signal], ([B Construction Materials Demand] - [B Construction Materials Demand Signal]) / [Construction Materials Demand Signal Adjustment Time], 0)

add_elements.description: Upward adjustment of colony B Construction Materials demand signal.

add_elements.name: B Construction Materials Demand Signal Decrease

behavior.value: IfThenElse([B Construction Materials Demand Signal] > [B Construction Materials Demand], ([B Construction Materials Demand Signal] - [B Construction Materials Demand]) / [Construction Materials Demand Signal Adjustment Time], 0)

add_elements.description: Downward adjustment of colony B Construction Materials demand signal.

add_elements.name: B Pre Energy Construction Materials Production Rate

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Enabled] = 1, [B Desired Construction Materials Production] / (1 + ([B Desired Construction Materials Production] / ([B Construction Materials Production Capacity] + 0.001)) ^ 8) ^ 0.125 * [B Regolith Inventory] / ([B Regolith Inventory] + [Regolith Buffer Days] * Max([B Regolith Requirement], 0.000000001)), 0)

add_elements.description: Colony B Construction Materials production plan before energy rationing; verbatim v7.7.1 production-rate formula.

add_elements.name: B Construction Materials Requested Energy

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Energy Enabled] = 1, [B Pre Energy Construction Materials Production Rate] * [Construction Materials Energy per Unit], 0)

add_elements.description: Energy requested by colony B Construction Materials processing.

add_elements.name: B Construction Materials Allocated Energy

behavior.value: [B Construction Materials Requested Energy] * [B Energy Fulfillment Ratio]

add_elements.description: Energy allocated to colony B Construction Materials processing by the common proportional allocator.

add_elements.name: B Construction Materials Energy Fulfillment Ratio

behavior.value: IfThenElse([B Construction Materials Requested Energy] > 0.001, [B Construction Materials Allocated Energy] / [B Construction Materials Requested Energy], 1)

add_elements.description: Energy fulfillment ratio of colony B Construction Materials processing.

replace_formulas.name: A Construction Materials Production Rate
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Energy Enabled] = 1, [A Pre Energy Construction Materials Production Rate] * [A Construction Materials Energy Fulfillment Ratio], IfThenElse([Construction Materials Enabled] = 1, [A Desired Construction Materials Production] / (1 + ([A Desired Construction Materials Production] / ([A Construction Materials Production Capacity] + 0.001)) ^ 8) ^ 0.125 * [A Regolith Inventory] / ([A Regolith Inventory] + [Regolith Buffer Days] * Max([A Regolith Requirement], 0.000000001)), 0))

replace_formulas.name: A Desired Construction Materials Production
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Energy Enabled] = 1, Max(0, [A Construction Materials Demand Signal] + ([A Construction Materials Demand Signal] * [Construction Materials Target Days] - [A Construction Materials Inventory]) / [Construction Materials Adjustment Time]), Max(0, [A Construction Materials Demand] + ([A Construction Materials Target Inventory] - [A Construction Materials Inventory]) / [Construction Materials Adjustment Time]))

replace_formulas.name: A Total Requested Energy
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Energy Enabled] = 1, [A Metal Requested Energy] + [A Electronics Requested Energy] + [A Construction Materials Requested Energy], [A Metal Requested Energy] + [A Electronics Requested Energy])

replace_formulas.name: A Energy Supply
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Energy Enabled] = 1, [A Metal Allocated Energy] + [A Electronics Allocated Energy] + [A Construction Materials Allocated Energy], [A Metal Allocated Energy] + [A Electronics Allocated Energy])

replace_formulas.name: B Construction Materials Production Rate
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Energy Enabled] = 1, [B Pre Energy Construction Materials Production Rate] * [B Construction Materials Energy Fulfillment Ratio], IfThenElse([Construction Materials Enabled] = 1, [B Desired Construction Materials Production] / (1 + ([B Desired Construction Materials Production] / ([B Construction Materials Production Capacity] + 0.001)) ^ 8) ^ 0.125 * [B Regolith Inventory] / ([B Regolith Inventory] + [Regolith Buffer Days] * Max([B Regolith Requirement], 0.000000001)), 0))

replace_formulas.name: B Desired Construction Materials Production
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Energy Enabled] = 1, Max(0, [B Construction Materials Demand Signal] + ([B Construction Materials Demand Signal] * [Construction Materials Target Days] - [B Construction Materials Inventory]) / [Construction Materials Adjustment Time]), Max(0, [B Construction Materials Demand] + ([B Construction Materials Target Inventory] - [B Construction Materials Inventory]) / [Construction Materials Adjustment Time]))

replace_formulas.name: B Total Requested Energy
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Energy Enabled] = 1, [B Metal Requested Energy] + [B Electronics Requested Energy] + [B Construction Materials Requested Energy], [B Metal Requested Energy] + [B Electronics Requested Energy])

replace_formulas.name: B Energy Supply
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Construction Materials Energy Enabled] = 1, [B Metal Allocated Energy] + [B Electronics Allocated Energy] + [B Construction Materials Allocated Energy], [B Metal Allocated Energy] + [B Electronics Allocated Energy])

replace_formulas.name: Test 26 Energy Kernel Capacity Shock Active
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Timed Test Mode] = 26, [Temporary Test Window], IfThenElse([Timed Test Mode] = 33, [Temporary Test Window], 0))
